title: Research: extend the one-frame-relation bound to arbitrary register counts
body:
A formal word with arbitrary register count and at most one rational relation among its k rank-one paid frames cannot produce diagonal target frames with total rank above k. The written proof extends Ali Romman's retained three-register argument using an arbitrary-dimensional pattern classification and Laurent-domain idempotents, including restored dirty roles. Finite projector/conjugation controls corroborate the proof; they do not establish the arbitrary-register theorem by themselves.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/83b6ad2ace819a96128131a3600ee914a66dd0dd/research/bit-one-relation-any-registers/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
